This list describes events that occurred from 1990 to 1991.

Events of the First Gulf War

• ___________________________________ ?
• President George H. W. Bush created an international coalition.
• NATO allies joined Saudi Arabia, Syria, and Egypt.

Which event replaces the question mark?

options.label: A
options.text: Iraqi leaders were assassinated in Kuwaiti territory.

options.label: B
options.text: Kuwaiti citizens were taken hostage by Iraqi forces.

options.label: D
options.text: Iraq invaded the nation of Kuwait.
